boundaries: BoxModel0, solid line, full visible border, corner radius0, no image/inner shadow, opaque border and fill.

M3b8 is a source-proven shape0/15 false predicate facade; rectangle records execute r5Am. Radio executes o3bT up to IL270 (fill/stroke path production), n5va/k5v0 and their recorded loops; unrelated later outline-cache conversion is not run.
Circle template executes exact initializer block IL33..386. Matrix/list/final segment constructors are explicit facades, not final SVG serialization.
Collection/property/point/rect arithmetic are explicit sinks; no original DLL execution or browser pixel validation.
